title: Matrix 90-Degree Rotation
statement:
Given an N×N matrix of integers, rotate it 90 degrees clockwise in-place and print the result.

For a 90-degree clockwise rotation, element at position (i, j) moves to position (j, N-1-i).

Equivalently:
1. Transpose the matrix (swap A[i][j] with A[j][i]).
2. Reverse each row.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The next N lines each contain N space-separated integers representing the matrix rows.
outputFormat: Print the rotated N×N matrix: N lines each with N space-separated integers.

examples.explanation: After rotating 90° clockwise: first column (bottom to top) becomes first row.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
matrix = []
for _ in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    matrix.append(row)
